SIMULATED BUSINESS. This is a fictional policy for a synthetic company. It is not real.

1. This policy governs marketplace sellers who fulfil orders through the platform. It does not apply to customer refund requests, which are governed by the Refund Policy.
2. Sellers must accept a return request within 30 days of the delivery date for any item that is not flagged final_sale.
3. For defective items the seller return window is 60 days from the delivery date.
4. Return shipping for a seller fault is paid by the seller and charged against the next settlement.
5. A seller must issue the buyer refund within 5 business days of receiving the returned item.
6. Sellers may auto-approve returns with a refund value of up to 20000 cents; above that the return goes to marketplace review.
7. Digital goods sold by a seller are non-returnable once the buyer has accessed them.
8. Sellers must mark an item final_sale in the listing before purchase; an item that was not marked cannot be refused on that ground.
9. Disputed returns are decided by marketplace review within 10 business days of the dispute being opened.
10. A seller who repeatedly refuses valid returns may have payouts held.
